description: Workday supplier Tax ID Type values by ISO country code, so Tax ID Type cascades from Tax ID Country Code. Supplier-specific: built from the Supplier EIB's own Tax_ID_Types range, which differs from the customer-sourced ref_country_tax_id_type. source='tenant' rows come from the workbook; source='fallback' rows give 'TIN' for ref_country codes the workbook has no tax ID type for (same fallback rule as the customer lookup).
provenance: Transcribed 2026-10-12 from the Supplier EIB's Tax_ID_Types / Ref ID / Tax Country ranges ('Tenant Default Named Ranges'!AC/AD/AE, `/Users/Rakesh.Patel/Documents/__data/excel/threeplus/CCS/FA E2E Suppliers V1.xlsm`). A snapshot, not a link. Counts: 799 raw rows; 2 repeat a (tax_id_type, country) display pair with a different Ref ID (Eritrea TIN: ERI-TIN/ESH-TIN; Rwanda TIN: RWA-TIN/SAM-TIN), first kept, leaving 797 distinct pairs; joined by country name to ref_country.json (106 rows) - 537 kept, 260 dropped (129 tenant countries not in ref_country, including Eritrea and Rwanda; ref_country is not extended - see ap_supplier open_questions); 4 TIN fallback rows for ref_country codes with no tenant type (AX, BL, MF, PM); 541 rows in total. Country-name alias map applied before the join (tenant name -> ref_country name): 'Czech Republic' -> 'Czechia'; 'Côte D'Ivoire' -> 'Côte d'Ivoire'; 'Macedonia, the Former Yugoslav Republic of' -> 'North Macedonia'. Sorted by country_code (tenant order within a country) so each country's rows are one contiguous Excel range.
